package myce

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestWriteSubmissionLegacyFixture(t *testing.T) {
	dir := t.TempDir()
	path := filepath.Join(dir, "legacy.db")
	c := &fakeClock{now: time.Date(2026, 10, 17, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)}
	q, err := Open(path, dir, c)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := q.update(func() error {
		s := Spec{Name: "legacy", Project: "test", Priority: "experiment"}
		s.Run.Command = []string{"echo", "legacy"}
		s.Needs.MemoryGB = 1
		s.Needs.Platform.Any = true
		q.s.Jobs["legacy-job"] = &Job{ID: "legacy-job", Spec: s, State: "queued", Queued: c.Now(), Checkpoint: "checkpoints/legacy-job"}
		return nil
	}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := q.Close(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile("../../../../internal/myce/testdata/submission-legacy.db", data, 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
